collection.title: Alfa Romeo GT 2005 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Alfa Romeo GT 2005 to 2010 model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
